assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9).
The patient has a need to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm over an extended period.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated.
The monitoring is intended to evaluate for intermittent conduction abnormalities or atrial fibrillation.
This appeal contests denial code PR-204.
The documented clinical indications support medical necessity for this diagnostic monitoring service.
